messages:
alex: Heads-up: RFC follow-up — proposal to move RBAC prefilter to a thin inline layer in the console query service, and push full auth checks to auth-service. Pros/cons thread.
priya: +1 to discussing. main worry is added RTT for auth-service calls.
jen: what's the latency budget? console SLO is 150ms tail for dashboards.
alex: Right. idea is prefilter to short-circuit ~80% of queries with cached grants. Only miss => auth-service sync call. Prefer sync fallback for correctness.
mike: What's miss rate expected? current auth cache TTL 30s has ~8% miss on heavy dashboards.
priya: With tenant pinning + warmups I think we can get miss down to 2-3%.
jen: Implementation sketch:
```
- console: prefilter (local LRU per instance) -> if hit, attach grants -> proceed
- if miss: call auth-service /v1/check?req=... -> attach grants -> cache
- fallback: if auth-service down -> conservatively block or allow-read-only?
```
alex: Tradeoffs:
- latency: +1 RPC on miss
- cost: auth-service qps increase
- correctness: centralize policy in auth-service
- rollout: start as opt-in per-route then global
priya: rollout plan suggestion: feature-flag per-route, 10% users -> 50% -> 100%. monitor miss latency, error-rate, dashboard tail lat.
jen: Metrics to add: auth.prefilter.hit, auth.prefilter.miss, auth.remote.latency_p50/p95, console.query.tail_latency_with_auth
mike: Can we do async validation for non-blocking reads? e.g., allow but mark audit; then later revoke?
alex: Maybe for non-critical dashboards, but too risky for sensitive data. Better to have a per-route policy toggle.
priya: Ops concerns: cache invalidation when grants change. Use publish/subscribe from auth-service to console instances.
jen: Schema change needed: attach 'grants_v' header with grant identifier so we can track staleness.
alex: Code-level: small prefilter middleware in console Go service. pseudocode:
```
func AuthPrefilter(req){
  key := tenant+route
  if g:=localCache.Get(key); g!=nil { req.Headers.Set("X-Grants", g.id); return proceed }
  g := authClient.Check(req)
  localCache.Set(key,g)
  req.Headers.Set("X-Grants", g.id)
}
```
mike: What about multi-tenant noisy cache? per-instance LRU could thrash.
priya: We should size cache by tenant weight; heavy tenants get larger shard.
jen: Feature flags: ff_auth_prefilter_v2 with rollout config. we also need canary dashboard to test E2E.
alex: Action items:
- priya: prototype middleware + local cache (1 week)
- jen: add metrics and flags (this sprint)
- mike: load test auth-service qps and failure modes (next week)
- ops: plan pub/sub for grant invalidation
priya: noted. I'll post a short RFC update with perf numbers after prototype :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: canary triggered for auth-prefilter on env=staging
mike: thanks, will watch latency dashboards
alex: cool — let's sync Fri 11 for short demo.
